newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries flat at open despite weak dollar.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries flat at open despite weak dollar.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury bond market was unchanged at the open after wavering a bit overnight on the back of a sharp drop in the dollar, analysts said.

With a heavy offering of important U.S. economic data to digest this week, Treasuries may be in a holding pattern until Tuesday, when the market gets a taste of April retail sales, the first numbers to be dished up, experts said.
"The dollar may start bothering people but I don't know how badly the market can do until you get retail sales," said Cary Leahey, senior economist at Lehman Government Securities.
